privacy.title: Personal data processing
privacy.text: Notice about data supplied through the VIKUB enquiry and seminar registration forms, under Article 13 of Regulation (EU) 2016/679 (GDPR) and the Italian Personal Data Protection Code (Legislative Decree 196/2003, as amended). Version dated 8 September 2026.

sections.title: 1. Data controller
paragraphs: The data controller is Mario Ubaldi, a sole trader operating under the VIKUB brand. Location: Fano, Italy.
For data protection questions and to exercise your rights, contact info@vikub.com or call +39 328 2303160.

sections.title: 2. Data processed
paragraphs: Enquiry form: name, email, phone, company, selected topic and message. Registration form: first name, last name, company, email and phone, if provided.

The forms also process language, request type, consent indication, submission date and time, IP address and browser information; registrations include the event identifier and date. Submissions are recorded in a server log and sent to VIKUB by email.
Do not include passwords, payment details, health information or other sensitive data unnecessary for your request.

sections.title: 3. Purposes and lawful bases
paragraphs: Enquiry data is used to assess your request, contact you and prepare a response. Registration data is used to organise participation in the selected seminar, send the joining link and event-related administrative messages.

For these purposes, the lawful basis is your consent under Article 6(1)(a) GDPR, given through a separate, unticked checkbox in the relevant form. Consent covers only the stated purpose. Submitting a form does not subscribe you to advertising newsletters or authorise sharing your contact details with partners for their advertising.

Technical data is used to operate the forms, prevent spam and protect the website on the basis of the controller’s legitimate interest under Article 6(1)(f) GDPR in maintaining a secure, reliable service, taking your rights into account. Processing necessary to meet legal obligations is based on Article 6(1)(c) GDPR.

sections.title: 4. Providing data and withdrawing consent
paragraphs: Providing data is voluntary; there is no legal obligation to complete these forms. All displayed enquiry fields are required. Registration requires first name, last name, company and email; phone is optional. The site will not submit a form without the required fields and the consent checkbox.

You can withdraw consent at any time by writing to info@vikub.com, without affecting the lawfulness of earlier processing. Processing based on consent then stops; without necessary data, a further response or participation arrangements may not be possible. Data subject to a separate legal retention obligation is processed only within that obligation’s limits.

sections.title: 5. Storage, access and recipients
paragraphs: VIKUB receives the submissions and stores them on internal servers used by VIKUB. Access is restricted to Mario Ubaldi and authorised VIKUB personnel, within their responsibilities and subject to confidentiality.

Website and email service providers may process data in delivering technical services; where they act on the controller’s behalf, their processing must be governed by Article 28 GDPR. Data may be disclosed to competent authorities where a lawful basis exists. Submissions are not published, and receiving a submission does not authorise sharing contact details indiscriminately with partners or speakers.

sections.title: 6. Retention period
paragraphs: Enquiries, registrations and related correspondence are kept for no more than 6 months from receipt of the corresponding enquiry or registration. Data is deleted earlier where the purpose has been achieved and further retention is unnecessary, or following a justified erasure request or withdrawal of consent if no other lawful basis applies.

Technical logs controlled by VIKUB are kept only as long as security requires, and no longer than 6 months from recording. At expiry, the data and copies managed by VIKUB must be deleted or irreversibly anonymised.

Longer retention is limited to specific information needed to comply with law or establish, exercise or defend legal claims, for the duration of the relevant obligation or dispute. If an enquiry leads to a contract, necessary contractual and accounting records are handled separately under applicable requirements. VIKUB’s period does not determine retention for external platforms’ independent processing.

sections.title: 7. Seminar on Google Meet
paragraphs: The seminar takes place on Google Meet. VIKUB does not upload its submission database or messages received through the website forms to Google Meet; participants are sent a joining link.

When you join, Google processes data needed to operate the platform: participant name, account information if an account is used, IP address, device and connection information, and audio, video, chat and shared materials when you use those features. Your name and material shared in the meeting may be visible to other participants.

Platform processing depends on the account type and service terms. Google’s information is available at policies.google.com/privacy. Consent in the registration form is not separate consent to recording the meeting or publishing your image or voice; if such processing is planned, the organiser provides advance information and identifies an appropriate lawful basis.

sections.title: 8. International processing
paragraphs: Using Google Meet and other external internet services may involve processing outside the European Economic Area. Google’s information on international processing and relevant mechanisms is available at policies.google.com/privacy/frameworks.

Transfers for which VIKUB is responsible are permitted only in accordance with Chapter V GDPR, on the basis of an applicable adequacy decision or other necessary safeguards, including standard contractual clauses where appropriate. Information about the particular recipients, processing countries and safeguards relevant to your data can be requested at info@vikub.com.

sections.title: 9. Your rights
paragraphs: Subject to GDPR conditions, you may request access, rectification, erasure, restriction and portability, and object to processing based on legitimate interests. Portability applies to automated processing based on consent or a contract. You may also withdraw consent.

Send requests to info@vikub.com. Responses are provided without undue delay, normally within one month. If an extension of up to two further months is needed under the GDPR, you will be told about it and the reasons within the first month.

You may complain to the competent supervisory authority, including Italy’s Garante per la protezione dei dati personali: www.garanteprivacy.it. Contacting VIKUB first is not a prerequisite for lodging a complaint.

sections.title: 10. Website technical services and analytics
paragraphs: Static pages are hosted on GitHub Pages, while forms submit to the handler on vikub.com. Infrastructure providers may process technical connection data during your visit; this does not amount to sharing the submission database with them.

Google Analytics is activated only after separate consent in the analytics banner. Form consent does not include analytics consent. Refusing analytics does not prevent form submission; your choice can be changed through “Analytics settings” in the footer. The browser remembers the choice for 180 days, which is not the retention period for submissions or Google data.

Submissions are not subject to decisions based solely on automated processing that produce legal or similarly significant effects; field validation and spam checks do not themselves constitute such decisions.
